description_en: Submits a trace watermark extraction job
description_zh: 提交溯源水印提取任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-trace-extract-job --input Type=OSS Media=oss://bucket/object --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitTraceExtractJob

fields.help_en:
The input source. Specify an OSS object URL or a media asset ID.

An OSS object URL can be in one of the following formats:

1. oss\://bucket/object

In these formats, `bucket` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as your IMS service, and `object` is the path of the OSS object
fields.help_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为：

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The input type. Valid values:

OSS: An OSS object URL.

Media: A media asset ID
fields.help_zh:
输入类型，取值：

OSS：OSS文件地址。

Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The input video from which to extract the watermark.

The OSS object or media asset must be in the same region as your IMS service
parameters.help_zh:
待提取水印的视频文件。


OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The user-defined data. Maximum length: 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
Extraction job parameters, specified as a JSON string. The following parameters are supported:

`m3u8Type`: The algorithm type. The default value is `v1`.

`v1`: Extracts an m3u8 playlist with absolute paths.

`v2`: Extracts an m3u8 playlist with relative paths
parameters.help_zh:
提取任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

m3u8Type：算法类型，默认值为v1。

v1：提取绝对路径的m3u8。
v2：提取相对路径的m3u8
parameters.name: params
